comparisons.reason: Both are any-comment binary features over OC_comments, but they measure different constructs. Feature 0 asks for a specific, localized example (a named or clearly identified case, person, event or organization). Feature 1 asks for specific numerical data or statistics. A comment can cite a specific example with no numbers, and it can cite statistics with no particular instance. Feature 1 also says non-quantitative examples score 0, so the two predicates can disagree on the same row.
